Bhagavad Gita Chapter 1, Verse 15

अर्जुनविषादयोग

Shlok 15 (sloka 15) of adhyaya 1 — Arjuna Vishada Yoga (अर्जुनविषादयोग), from the Bhagavad Geeta or Bhagavat Gita (भगवद्गीता). Open in Ask Krishna.

Open this verse in Ask Krishna

Sanskrit (Devanagari)

पाञ्चजन्यं हृषीकेशो देवदत्तं धनञ्जयः |
पौण्ड्रं दध्मौ महाशङ्खं भीमकर्मा वृकोदरः ||१-१५||

English meaning

Hrishikesha blew the Panchajanya and Arjuna blew the Devadatta
and Bhima (the wolf-bellied), the doer of terrible deeds, blew the great
conch Paundra.

Hindi meaning

भगवान् हृषीकेश ने पांचजन्य, धनंजय (अर्जुन) ने देवदत्त तथा भयंकर कर्म करने वाले भीम ने पौण्डू नामक महाशंख बजाया।
